name: Bubble pack
oneLiner: glass bubbles sized by value float in from their own sides and gather round an empty centre, each naming its part as its number counts; then the biggest swells up in the centre in the accent, shoulders the rest outward in a ripple, names itself and counts its value up
say: when the speaker says where most of something comes from ('most of our traffic is search, the rest is a long tail'): cut in on the breakdown, the biggest bubble swells into the centre on the word that names it
